rows.source_exact: VII. [Foris Cripte] - Limpha foris cripte iuxta maris edita litus
rows.content_obligation: The named water emerges/is situated beside the sea shore.
rows.representation_scope: `LOCATE(W,NEAR(sea_shore))`; introduction of the named bath/water. “edita” retains emergence versus situation as a lexical nuance.

rows.source_exact: A stomacho pellit debilitatis onus.
rows.content_obligation: It removes the burden of weakness from the stomach.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,stomach,REMOVE(weakness))`; burden metaphor retained in the wording, not a separate measured load.

rows.source_exact: Sed nocet ydropicis, cum sit dulcissima potu:
rows.content_obligation: It harms dropsical recipients although very sweet to drink.
rows.representation_scope: `CONTRAST(ATTRIBUTE(W,sweet,drink,very),AFFECT(W,P[hydrops],harm))`; sweetness is no positive-effect entailment.

rows.source_exact: Vim consumendi non habet, unde nocet
rows.content_obligation: It lacks a consuming/reducing power; that explains the harm.
rows.representation_scope: `CAUSE(NEGATE(HAS_POWER(W,consume)),harm76)`; object of “consume” is not supplied by the line. Do not silently insert a particular humour.

rows.source_exact: Leniter ignitos assueta refrigerat artus.
rows.content_obligation: It is accustomed to cool heated limbs gently.
rows.representation_scope: `HABITUAL(AFFECT(W,limbs[heated],cool,gently))`; ALIM ignitos versus native inignitos/ignitos reading noted below.

rows.source_exact: Pulmonem lesum sanat et inde Jecur.
rows.content_obligation: It heals an injured lung and then/also the liver.
rows.representation_scope: Two owned effects on lung and liver; `inde` leaves temporal versus connective nuance open. Injury is explicit for lung, not automatically copied to liver.

rows.source_exact: Pectoris antidotum, tussis medicamen amicum.
rows.content_obligation: It is a remedy for the chest and a friendly remedy for cough.
rows.representation_scope: Two benefit descriptions, chest and cough; “friendly” evaluative modifier retained. They are not two identical claims about one organ.

rows.source_exact: Desiccata febris caumate membra rigat
rows.content_obligation: It moistens limbs dried by the burning heat of fever.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,limbs[DRIED_BY(heat[fever])],moisten)`; causal qualification belongs to the patient's limbs.

rows.source_exact: Ip[s]a per occultos telluris ducta meatus
rows.content_obligation: That water is led through hidden passages of the earth.
rows.representation_scope: `PASSAGE(W,hidden(earth_channels))`; same referent as next line, not a new independent application command.

rows.source_exact: Subuenit egrotis est quibus egra cutis.
rows.content_obligation: It helps sick people whose skin is diseased.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,P[sick AND diseased(skin)],benefit)`; the skin condition is retained.

rows.source_exact: Ut dicunt veteres: satis est mirabile dictu.
rows.content_obligation: The ancients are cited; the stated matter is remarkable to tell.
rows.representation_scope: `REPORT(ancients,claim85)` plus `EVALUATE(claim85,remarkable)` is the provisional forward scope; a wider closing scope remains possible.

rows.source_exact: Ipsa foris cripte bulla ministrat aquam.
rows.content_obligation: A water-supply relation involving Foris Cripte and Bulla.
rows.representation_scope: `SUPPLY(source,destination,water)` with unresolved orientation across witnesses; no fixed Bulla-to-Foris edge is licensed from this collation.

rows.source_exact: Ascribunt homines tibi, nastasia, lauacrum
rows.content_obligation: People attribute/dedicate this bath to Anastasia.
rows.representation_scope: `ATTRIBUTE(people,B,Anastasia)`; an attribution statement, not merely an arbitrary bath-name token.

rows.source_exact: Usibus humanis comoda multa facit.
rows.content_obligation: It provides many advantages for human use.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(B,human_use,benefit,many)`; general evaluative introduction.

rows.source_exact: Corporis ingrati recreatos efficit artus.
rows.content_obligation: It refreshes the limbs of the “ingratus” body.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,limbs(body[ingratus]),refresh)`; sick/unpleasant/ungrateful nuance is not resolved into a new clinical diagnosis.

rows.source_exact: Virtutes eciam corporis unda novat.
rows.content_obligation: The water also renews the body's powers.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,powers(body),renew)`; renewal here concerns bodily powers, not replacement of the water in134.

rows.source_exact: Res miranda quidem quicunq[u]e cauabit arenam,
rows.content_obligation: A remarkable fact: whoever digs the sand…
rows.representation_scope: `EVALUATE(claim128,remarkable)` and `CONDITION(DIG(P,sand),claim128)`; not a completed event in one patient's biography.

rows.source_exact: In medio fosse feruida manat aqua.
rows.content_obligation: …hot water flows in the middle of the hole.
rows.representation_scope: `FLOW(W[hot],AT(middle(hole_from127)))`; owner of the hole is the digging clause.

rows.source_exact: Illa recens in fonte suo sinthomata tollit,
rows.content_obligation: That water, fresh in its own spring, removes symptoms…
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W[fresh AND at(own_spring)],P,REMOVE(symptoms))`, under130.

rows.source_exact: Languidus ardorem si paciatur aque.
rows.content_obligation: …if the sick person can endure the water's heat.
rows.representation_scope: `CONDITION(ENDURE(P[sick],heat(W)),claim129)`; this is a recipient guard, not a guarantee for every user.

rows.source_exact: Fonte relicta suo nichil affert utilitatis;
rows.content_obligation: Removed from its spring, it brings no utility.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W[removed_from(own_spring)],P,utility,none)`; **not** “water left at its source”.

rows.source_exact: Hec eadem prodest frigida facta parum.
rows.content_obligation: The same water, made cold, is of little benefit.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W[cooled],P,benefit,little)`; same kind/referent is stated, but no executed cooling event or location is fixed.

rows.source_exact: Qui petit ergo sui bene de langore iuuari,
rows.content_obligation: Whoever seeks good relief from their illness…
rows.representation_scope: `SEEK(P,RELIEF(own_illness,well))`; native witness says cito, quickly, in place of ALIM bene, well.

rows.source_exact: Senciet auxilium, si renouabit aquam.
rows.content_obligation: …will experience help if they renew the water.
rows.representation_scope: `CONDITION(RENEW(P,W),AFFECT(W,P,benefit))`; antecedent P comes from133. Water replacement versus refreshing is a lexical uncertainty, not automatic physical identity conservation.

rows.source_exact: XIX. [Culma] - Inter aquas alias mirabile culma lauacrum.
rows.content_obligation: Culma is remarkable among other baths/waters.
rows.representation_scope: `COMPARE(B,other_baths,remarkable)`; an introduction and evaluation.

rows.source_exact: Huius ad accessum non via recta patet.
rows.content_obligation: Its approach has no straight path.
rows.representation_scope: `NEGATE(STRAIGHT(path_to(B)))`; concerns access, not water flow.

rows.source_exact: Ymo per obliquum medicis accreditur undis;
rows.content_obligation: Instead the waters are reached by a winding/oblique route.
rows.representation_scope: `APPROACH(P,W,oblique_path)`; ALIM medicis versus native apparent modicas is left as a source variant.

rows.source_exact: Monstrat iter dubium preuia flamma tibi.
rows.content_obligation: A flame going ahead shows the uncertain way to you.
rows.representation_scope: `SHOW(preceding_flame,path[uncertain],P)`; an access aid, not a written heating operation on the water.

rows.source_exact: Unda lateris intus sudorem prouocat intus.
rows.content_obligation: The interior/hidden water provokes sweating within.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,P,CAUSE(sweating))`; native latens versus ALIM lateris changes the description of W and is retained.

rows.source_exact: Et facit ad neruos quos graue flegma grauat.
rows.content_obligation: It helps nerves weighed down by heavy phlegm/rheum.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,nerves[BURDENED_BY(heavy(humour))],benefit)`; the two witnesses use flegma/reuma. No automatic modern diagnostic equivalence.

rows.source_exact: Luminibus lumen reddit, vestigia claudis,
rows.content_obligation: It restores sight to eyes and steps to the lame…
rows.representation_scope: Two restoration effects: vision and walking; guard226 provisionally scopes both.

rows.source_exact: Passio ni fuerit inueterata diu.
rows.content_obligation: …unless the ailment has been established for a long time.
rows.representation_scope: `CONDITION(NOT(longstanding(D)),effects225)`; not an unconditional cure. A broader backward scope would be a different source analysis.

rows.source_exact: Rem loquitur certam non est incognita multis:
rows.content_obligation: The assertion is called certain and known to many.
rows.representation_scope: `REPORT(speaker,certainty(claim228))` and `KNOWN_TO(claim228,many)`; provisional forward scope, not independent clinical evidence.

rows.source_exact: Culma nocet sanis, morbida membra iuuat.
rows.content_obligation: Culma harms the healthy and helps diseased limbs.
rows.representation_scope: Two recipient-conditioned effects of opposite polarity; generic “helps” does not erase the specific chronicity guard on225.

rows.source_exact: Hac igitur caueat ui non eget arte medendi;
rows.content_obligation: Therefore one who does not need treatment should avoid it.
rows.representation_scope: `ADVISE(P[NOT(need_treatment)],AVOID(B))`; a recommendation with a recipient condition.

rows.source_exact: Quam si forte peti, nitet in amne moram.
rows.content_obligation: One who nevertheless seeks it should avoid lingering in the water.
rows.representation_scope: Native `uitet … moram` supports `ADVISE(visitor,AVOID(long_stay_in_water))`; ALIM's nitet/peti wording is not silently replaced. Antecedent scope, all visitors versus the preceding healthy person, remains explicitly open.

rows.source_exact: XXXIII. [De Cruce] - Hoc lauacrum Crucis satis est laudabilis unda.
rows.content_obligation: The water/bath of the Cross is strongly praised.
rows.representation_scope: `EVALUATE(W_of_Cross,praiseworthy,very)`; witness rubric says Sancta Lucia while the body says Crucis. Keep both identities, not a silent equation.

rows.source_exact: Quibus podagra iam indurata fuit.
rows.content_obligation: The praise/benefit concerns people whose gout is already hardened/has dominated.
rows.representation_scope: `RECIPIENT(P[podagra AND established])` attached to393; ALIM iam indurata and native condominata differ.

rows.source_exact: Confortata neruos et fleuma expellit ab ip[s]is
rows.content_obligation: It strengthens nerves and expels phlegm from them.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,nerves,strengthen)` and `EXPEL(W,phlegm,FROM(nerves))`; them has an explicit local owner.

rows.source_exact: Prodest ydropicis qui exfleumate grosso.
rows.content_obligation: It helps dropsical recipients with a specified phlegmatic cause.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,P[hydrops CAUSED_BY(phlegm[qualifier])],benefit)`; qualifier ALIM grosso, native salso. Do not remove this condition to manufacture an exact counterpart to VII.

rows.source_exact: Consueuit eam splene tumente Jecur.
rows.content_obligation: A clause mentioning consumption, a swollen spleen and liver.
rows.representation_scope: ALIM Consueuit eam versus native Ipsam consumit: syntax/argument direction unresolved. No definite cure or consumption triple is asserted. This blocks a fully resolved four-record compiler.

rows.source_exact: Proficit et ventris qui ypocondri grauat.
rows.content_obligation: It benefits a belly suffering a hypochondrial burden.
rows.representation_scope: `AFFECT(W,belly[BURDENED_BY(hypochondrial_condition)],benefit)`; source grammar differs across witnesses. Preserve the historical category, not a modern psychiatric meaning.

rows.source_exact: Ad guttam frigidam que est imbita neruis
rows.content_obligation: For cold gout lodged in the nerves…
rows.representation_scope: `RECIPIENT(P[cold_gout AT(nerves)])`, governing advice400.

rows.source_exact: Frequentant aquam que euacuata crescit.
rows.content_obligation: …frequent the water, which grows as it is emptied.
rows.representation_scope: `ADVISE(P,REPEAT(visit(W)))` and `RELATION(emptying(W),increase(W))`; not an unbounded physical law or self-replicating volume.

rows.source_exact: Vidi quendam ego ad balneum sepe balneare
rows.content_obligation: The speaker saw someone repeatedly bathe/visit here.
rows.representation_scope: `WITNESS(speaker,REPEAT(visit(P0,B)))`; an explicitly introduced individual.

rows.source_exact: Qui minime poterat ad os porrigere manum
rows.content_obligation: That person had been unable to bring a hand/hands to the mouth.
rows.representation_scope: `NEGATE(ABLE(P0,BRING(hand,TO(mouth))))`; same P0, not a new generic patient.

rows.source_exact: Tempore in breui aque virtute fluendi
rows.content_obligation: After a short time, through enjoyment of the water's power…
rows.representation_scope: `TEMPORAL(short_interval,claim404)` and `CAUSE(power(W),claim404)` are attributed by the speaker, not independently established.

rows.source_exact: Teste michi multo cito discessit sanus.
rows.content_obligation: …the person departed/returned healthy, under an explicit witness formula.
rows.representation_scope: `BECOME(P0,healthy)` plus return/departure and `WITNESS(...)`; ALIM many witnesses versus native Christ as witness are different claims, retained separately.
